Title: Public preview: Windows Server container support in Azure App Service

Body.Content:
Windows Server containers in Azure App Service are now available in public preview. Deployment of applications in Windows containers helps developers get more control over what's installed in their containers.

By supporting Windows containers on Azure App Service, we're enabling new opportunities for application modernization:

  • Lift and shift to PaaS
  • Applications with dependencies
  • Relaxed security restrictions
  • Third-party application migration

For more information, see the announcement blog post and quickstart documentation.
